verdict.rationale: First-party GitHub docs say you can ask OpenCode to fix an issue, and it will work in a new branch and submit a PR with all the changes. It is triggered by mentioning /opencode or /oc in a comment, runs in the GitHub Actions runner, and has a guided setup for the app, workflow and secrets. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the issue-to-PR flow, detail on iterating on or validating the PR (e.g. tests, review loops), and evidence for trackers other than GitHub.
